BiblicalUsage: A rising — the break of light — is what this word means, and it appears once, in Isaiah's vision of Jerusalem lifted up. ‘The Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.’ The dawn belongs to Zion because the LORD's glory has risen on her.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the rising Isaiah saw is still coming: nations drawn to a light that is not ours but His.
